name: Marcus
label: Multi-playlist builder weighing Apple Music
who: I am a Spotify user who manages many playlists and adds songs to several at once, and I have paid for a subscription. I care about playlist tools that let me add songs quickly, keep my liked songs visible, and avoid auto-playing video while I browse.
value_for_money: Says basic features like liking songs should not sit behind a paywall, and suspects new features will be bundled into a higher tier. Says they would pay an add-on to get the heart button back on mobile.
loyalty: Stays for the ability to add a song to several playlists at once. Has threatened to switch to Apple Music or unsubscribe over playlist changes and video clips.
pain_points: Liked songs are now mixed into the playlist update
Cannot see liked tracks inside playlists
Auto-playing video clips appear while browsing playlists
Playlists can no longer be shared
likes: Adding a song to several playlists at once
tone: Earnest and mildly exasperated, writing in full sentences with occasional swearing and all-caps emphasis.
